claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
Earth Day in 2026 falls on a Wednesday.
The first Earth Day was in 1970.
Earth Day in 2026 marks its 56th year since the first Earth Day in 1970.
The 2026 theme of Earth Day is "Our Power, Our Planet".
Earth Day was founded in 1970 by U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson and activist Denis Hayes.
Over one billion people in 193 countries participate in Earth Day annually.
EARTHDAY.ORG holds events throughout the week surrounding April 22.
